scenario.title: Single concern, cleanly resolved
patient_concerns: Is it normal to feel this tired after chemotherapy?

transcript.content: Is it normal to feel this tired after chemotherapy?
Yes, that's a very common and expected side effect at this stage of treatment. It should ease gradually over the next week.
Oh good, I was worried something else was wrong.
